Name: Exodilla Scavenger
Information:
**Exodilla**

Pods of exodilla remain scattered in the universe, living nomadic lives as scavengers among the stars. These groups are not unlike the more savage lizardfolk of Somnus Domina, who see other species as prey to be hunted or invaders to be defended against.

Information Sections.Title: Exodilla
Information Sections.Text: Pods of exodilla remain scattered in the universe, living nomadic lives as scavengers among the stars. These groups are not unlike the more savage lizardfolk of Somnus Domina, who see other species as prey to be hunted or invaders to be defended against.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exodilla attacks twice: once with its Bite, and once with its Meteorite Spear.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Meteorite Spear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target, or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Corrosive Spit
actions.description: One target the exodilla chooses within 60 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) acid damage on a failure.

bonus_actions.name: Flash Regeneration (1/Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The exodilla regains 13 (2d12) hit points, and if it uses its Multiattack on the same turn it can make one additional Bite attack or use its Corrosive Spit as part of it.
